tier2_structural.title: Wire SubagentStop + commit codegraph proposed_bus_updates (write-dead bus symbol layer)
tier2_structural.why: SubagentStop has ZERO registrations at SHA in repo/active/template; every codegraph proposed_bus_updates (focus_symbols/recent_findings) is computed and dropped because the 'downstream SubagentStop writer' the boundary rule and facade comment assert in present tense does not exist. New hook + new event registration + revalidation/TTL logic touching the single-writer bus contract; needs design pass on stale-proposal handling and premortem before shipping.

tier2_structural.title: Session-identity consolidation: collapse 7 schemes to one canonical getSessionId
tier2_structural.why: 7 getSessionId implementations with 4 distinct fallback semantics make state files, hook traces, guardrail acks, and coordination rows non-joinable by session — the mechanistic contributor to corr-null 60.7%. shared/index.ts barrel re-exports the ppid-scheme under the canonical name (silent per-process id). Cross-cutting refactor across coordination, Maestro/Ralph/plan hooks, logger, and barrel export; needs migration plan to avoid breaking file-claims/heartbeat.

tier2_structural.title: UserPromptSubmit hot-path latency: collapse 13 serial spawns + parallelize/cache recall
tier2_structural.why: Hot path serializes 13 process spawns (~22-32s worst-case before any prompt answers). memory-awareness docstring claims parallel but main() runs 4 sequential subprocesses; 2x uv cold starts (~2.2s each) per prompt; no result cache; ordering constraint (bus-session-populator must bump turn before memory-awareness reads). Requires resident-recall-daemon decision (ST-05) and careful ordering preservation.

tier2_structural.title: codegraph facade latency: 35-50s -> budget; per-dirty-file process fan-out
tier2_structural.why: ensureFresh spawns one full codegraph process per dirty/untracked file on every call with no source filter (telemetry: 16-88s/call, median ~62s, 10x the documented 3-4s). D4b-07: if forced full-reindex on 2804-file corpus exceeds 60s timeout the .indexed-head stamp never writes and every subsequent call re-attempts forever. Without this the >=80% C.5 adoption gate (currently 45.7%) is unreachable. Requires freshness-probe redesign and reindex-budget guarding.

tier2_structural.title: Resident recall daemon + recall result cache (memory hot-path boot tax)
tier2_structural.why: No resident recall daemon; ~2.2s Python interpreter boot paid twice per prompt. BGE daemon amortizes only the embedding model, not the interpreter. In-process embedding fallback (~30-45s cold load) cannot complete in the 12s SIGKILL budget — currently burns 12s and returns nothing. New long-lived process + lifecycle/health management + cache-invalidation design; BGE daemon precedent helps but recall has different state.

tier2_structural.title: Permission layer redesign: replace blanket permission-auto-allow
tier2_structural.why: permission-auto-allow auto-approves EVERY PermissionRequest except AskUserQuestion/ExitPlanMode (all Bash/Edit/Write/WebFetch), nullifying the OS permission dialog system-wide in normal mode — lives active-only with no repo/template representation. navigator-safety (already deregistered, source needs allow->ask rewrite); plan-mode gate downgrades deny->ask under --dangerously-skip-permissions on transcript failure; isRalphActive() has no TTL. Deliberate security-posture decision needing operator policy choice + blast-radius premortem.

tier2_structural.title: Complete the memory sanitizer coverage (poison-then-inject chain)
tier2_structural.why: WS-0.2 sanitizer covers only 2 of 5 live archival_memory->context injectors. session-start-continuity.ts (RAW 600-char) and pre-plan-memory.ts (RAW 1500-char) inject unsanitized recall output into SessionStart/EnterPlanMode context — the exact prompt-injection the sanitizer exists to stop. Security-sensitive change to what reaches model context at session boundaries; needs injector coverage audit and wrapper-contract design.

tier2_structural.title: Grep-path shell-injection: argv-ify smart-search-router + daemon-client fallbacks
tier2_structural.why: Three live injection surfaces fire on every Grep when TLDR daemon is down: smart-search-router ripgrepFallback string-interpolates model-controlled pattern into execSync cmd.exe string (escaping only " and $); daemon-client double-shells through PowerShell->cmd.exe (inner PS escapes ' only, outer cmd escapes " only — % & ^ < > | reach cmd.exe live). Spans search-router + daemon-client shell boundary on Windows; deny-message policy (3+-word hard-deny) needs behavioral decision beyond escaping.

tier2_structural.title: Bus lock + write-amplification hardening
tier2_structural.why: acquireLockSync 200ms cap is leaky (observed waits to 2293ms/11x; deadline checked on one branch only, 100% CPU spin). bus-tool-populator rewrites full JSON on every Read/Grep for a display-only grep_hit slice with zero behavioral consumer. CCV3_KILLSWITCH does not short-circuit the bus layer (design Q16 says master short-circuits all; bus checks only CCV3_BUS_OFF). Concurrency-correctness work on shared single-writer bus with measured contention (158 slow / 14 dropped writes).

tier2_structural.title: agent-recall-injector: fix the 0-for-78 agent memory surface (DELICATE file)
tier2_structural.why: agent-recall-injector has 0-for-78 lifetime memory yield since 2026-05-16: extractIntent passes entire multi-KB Task prompt as recall query AND the 3.5s budget is consumed by uv-run startup alone. 100% of recall benefit accrues to 'main' (zero sub-agent rows in 281 recall events) — agent layer is fully memory-blind. DELICATE: documented regression history (Hook Source Regression MEMORY.md); any edit requires emit-invariant guard + post-spark verification. Fix depends on ST-05 daemon to hit within budget.

Owns: scope classification correctness (D3a-04 short-keyword GLOBAL false-triggers mis-scoping PROJECT learnings), silent store failures (D3a-02 swallowed errors/ignore stdio), dead noise-prefix pipeline (D3a-05 agent-error-capture content gate-rejected before embedding while logging success), corpus-curation pass.
